title: KOHATS
description: Hats with helmet attributes in pure vanilla
body:
# KOHATS
KOHATS is a datapack and resourcepack. That adds hats and easier system for them using new dialog system. Also it's fully support English and Russian.
## How to use
1. Install and enable both datapack and resourcepack.
2. Hold helmet you want to convert in your hand and open KOHATS menu using button in `Pause Menu` or by pressing `Quick Action` (`G` by default).
![KOHATS Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4b1e275d94f4e6f182cbfb880207fe8b74b0e61.png)
3. Select hat you want (There you can see hat previews). If hat supports dye coloring. You can set color you want. For example you want color #EB4034. Open any hex to decimal converter and convert your color. For #EB4034 it will be 15417396. Press `Ok`.
![KOHATS Select Hat Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/776d9c2e903fbd92696032227685be462ccd8af6.png)
4. Minecraft will ask a confirmation. Press `Yes` and your helmet will be replaced with hat.
![Helmet replaced by hat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a827a52bc03ee1bafd4818a4cd9ace4a2f8a155_0.webp)
## Custom hats
You can use your custom hats. Model and translation key is required, tint is optional. However your hat wont appear in `Select Hat` dialog, but you still can get it in `Select Custom Hat` dialog by manually writing translation key and item model. Take a look at resource pack for examples.
## QA
1. Why use `Leather Horse Armor` instead of `Curved Pumpkin`?
    * `Leather Horse Armor` allow both, changing item model and dye coloring.
2. Why color select so ugly?
    * Currently it's best I can do with dialog limitations.
3. I can't get hat in multiplayer.
    * It's due dialog limitation of running at user permissions. So to use it you must have access to `/function` command.
